title: Thread game-loop family law (sleep/start/wake)
statement: Four stacked roots fixed: (1) ThreadShadow no-op swallowed sleep — sleep now blocks per semantics; (2) javac emits SUBCLASS descriptors for Thread.sleep/start — method_ids ground truth wins over literal types (is_thread_receiver DEX-chain law, 3 sites); (3) starts drained only in parks — frame-boundary start/yield drains (bounded 4/8); (4) no resume for sleep-blocked bodies — wake-time registry (thread->{target,wake}); sleep inside drained bodies records wake without advancing the shared clock. Documented deviations from wall-clock semantics remain in the notes.
